title: A 2023 social accounting matrix for China with income-decile households and financial accounts
description: Complete 67-account social accounting matrix for China in 2023 with ten income-decile household groups and financial accounts. Includes CSV, long-format and eight-sheet XLSX matrices, group-level validation, sensitivity and multiplier outputs, concordances and figures. CFPS confirmed public sharing of the stated group-level aggregate parameters without prior review or filing. No original survey records, provider workbooks or internal decile workbook are included. Authors' aggregate outputs are licensed CC BY 4.0; the source-data rights remain with their providers.
notes: Dataset version 1.0.0. GitHub mirror: https://github.com/wuwei0304/china-sam-2023-data. The code is separately archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23642715 under MIT. The software DOI is not the Dataset DOI.
